part.text:
## Cause

`examples/inventory-filter/site/app.js:5-14` — `render(showInStockOnly)` ignored its argument and hardcoded `const hide = false`, so toggling "In stock only" updated button state/count logic input but never hid out-of-stock items.

## Fix

- `examples/inventory-filter/site/app.js`: hide out-of-stock items when filtering is active:

```js
const hide = showInStockOnly && item.dataset.stock === "out";
```

This makes only the two `data-stock="in"` items visible when "In stock only" is pressed, yielding `2 items` and removing the `Out of stock` text from view. No files outside `examples/inventory-filter/site/` were changed.
